dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-lateral flank displays 4-5 prominent light-grey 'O' and 'C' shaped rings. These structures exhibit diffuse, irregular outer perimeters with a gradual luminance gradient transitioning from the dark charcoal background into a lighter grey ring, often containing a darker interior core. The edges are non-uniform with high-frequency pixel jitter.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high density of small, solid light-grey pixel clusters is visible on the anterior neck and lower ventral margins. These asymmetrical clusters lack internal luminance gradients and are concentrated in the transition zone between the neck and the torso.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the primary central 'O' annulus and two adjacent 'C' annuli form a scalene triangular relationship. A secondary set of four smaller annuli in the posterior dorsal region forms an irregular trapezoidal pattern when connecting their centroids.
